summary: Formalize full PTX ISA 9.4 and support reusable TorchLean-to-kernel verification.
Explain the computing model and verification contracts through source-linked documentation and reproducible examples.
remaining: Restricted message-passing, scoped non-torn candidates, allocation contracts and a scalar integer machine with local kernel proofs are implemented. Full PTX coverage, general dependent concurrent semantics, bytewise raced outcomes, TorchLean interfaces, numerical/backward infrastructure and application examples remain unimplemented.
